set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,subprocess,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
state=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads')
expected='58a206a6746e86ebcb8ed53f1fabbf9d45ff01a5'
assert (root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()==expected
sessions=list(vault.glob('*.session'))
assert len(sessions)==2
assert all(p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)&0o077==0 for p in sessions)
print('EXACT_SOURCE_PASS',expected)
print('TWO_SESSIONS_PRIVATE_PASS',len(sessions))
backups=root/'.telegram-leads-release-backups'
print('RECOVERY_BACKUP_EXISTS',any(p.name.startswith('from-3d53bf473fc0-to-58a206a6746e') and p.is_dir() for p in backups.iterdir()))
assert any(p.name.startswith('from-3d53bf473fc0-to-58a206a6746e') and p.is_dir() for p in backups.iterdir())
print('BACKUPS_TOTAL',sum(x.is_dir() for x in backups.iterdir()))
print('SCOPE_STATE_INTACT',all((state/name).is_file() for name in ('operation-state.json','public-groups.json','supervisor-events.jsonl')))
pm=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],env={**os.environ,'PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2'},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
assert pm.returncode==0
workers=[x for x in json.loads(pm.stdout) if x.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
assert len(workers)==1
meta=workers[0].get('pm2_env',{})
assert meta.get('pm_cwd')==str(root)
print('WORKER_STATUS',meta.get('status'))
print('WORKER_RESTART_COUNTER',meta.get('restart_time'))
for k in ('TELEGRAM_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED','TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED'):
 print('ENV_'+k,meta.get(k,'NOT_SET'))
logs=Path(meta.get('pm_out_log_path',''))
if logs.is_file() and not logs.is_symlink() and logs.stat().st_size>0:
 with logs.open('rb') as stream:
  end=stream.seek(0,2)
  stream.seek(max(0,end-60000))
  recent=stream.read().decode('utf-8','replace').splitlines()
 entries=[]
 for line in recent[-24:]:
  try: d=json.loads(line)
  except ValueError: continue
  if not isinstance(d,dict): continue
  entries.append({
   'status': d.get('status'),
   'public_discovery_status': d.get('public_discovery_status'),
   'group_actions_recorded': d.get('group_actions_recorded'),
   'groups_joined': d.get('groups_joined'),
   'blocked_actions': d.get('blocked_actions'),
   'member_actions_recorded': d.get('member_actions_recorded'),
  })
 print('RECENT_SANITIZED_WORKER_CYCLES',json.dumps(entries[-5:],sort_keys=True))
print('HYGIENE_STALE_BUNDLE_EXISTS',(root/'.telegram-leads-release-7c0ef8a1d9be.tgz').exists())
print('HYGIENE_TEST_MARKER_EXISTS',(state/'self-notification-test-20261031.json').exists())
print('READBACK_COMPLETE')
PY
